title: Studies on Origin-dependent Inverted-Repeat Amplification and Related Processes
summary: This cluster consists of research papers on various processes in organisms, specifically focusing on Origin-dependent inverted-repeat amplification, palindromic amplicons, and replication-based models. The papers were authored by a group of researchers including Brewer BJ, Dunham MJ, Payen C, and Raghuraman MK. The studies likely explore the mechanisms and implications of these processes in organisms, possibly including Saccharomyces, as it is a common subject in molecular biology research.
